name: PAY_GEOGRAPHY_INTERFACE
description: This interface table contains geography information from ORAMAST.txt file.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: For internal use only

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country to which the Geography belongs

columns.name: AREA1
columns.description: State jurisdiction code

columns.name: AREA2
columns.description: County jurisdiction code

columns.name: AREA3
columns.description: City jurisdiction code

columns.name: AREA4
columns.description: School District code

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this geography is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this geography is no longer valid.

columns.name: CREATION_VERSION
columns.description: Column to record the file version of third party content provider in which this record was first introduced

columns.name: LAST_UPDATION_VERSION
columns.description: Column to record the file version of third party content provider in which this record was last updated

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Abbreviation for country or state based on whether this record is for a country or state

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Complete name of Geography

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier for geographies

columns.name: START_RANGE
columns.description: Column for recording the lowest value in the zip code range

columns.name: END_RANGE
columns.description: Column for recording the highest value in the zip code range

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Column to indicate whether this geography record is to be inserted or updated

columns.name: IDENTIFIER_STATUS
columns.description: Column to indicate whether geocode and primary city geography identifier record is to be inserted or updated

columns.name: GEO_DATA_PROVIDER
columns.description: Name of the data source provider

columns.name: PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Name of the provider ID

columns.name: PARENT_PROVIDER_GEO_ID
columns.description: Name of the parent provider ID

columns.name: EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Name of the EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether the city and Township geography is primary geography

columns.name: MULTIPLE_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this geography has multiple parents.

columns.name: FILE_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: File version of third party data source provider

columns.name: FILE_VERSION_DATE
columns.description: File Version Date of third party data source provider

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Used to distinguish between English and French spellings for Canadian geographies.‘US’ and 'FRC' respectively indicate English and French  spellings of the geography.
